title: Ordinary Chern class after forgetting a normalized Cartier support
statement: Fix P, A and m=ell^n in [def-pur-conventions]. For a closed Cartier immersion i:D->T [def-pc-divisor-line-bundle] and a structure map a:T->Spec(k), let kappa be an Ext representative satisfying SupportedKummerBoundary [def-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer-boundary]. Let alpha be its supported Hom representative with HEq kappa.hom alpha [lem-pur-supported-cup-functoriality]. There is an ordinary module Ext representative c1 whose Hom equals functorialCupForget false i alpha, and whose ordinaryFiniteClass is the supportedKummerChern of the dual Cartier ideal with its canonical complementary section. The same ordinary representative is compatible with forgetting the pro-etale comparison class, by the supportedCupFunctoriality forget-support law. No family, local-equation calculation, sum formula or Cartier geometry is asserted.

proof.text: The restriction closedConstantSectionMap is the adjunct of the canonical pullback isomorphism on constants, hence supportedConstantUnit. This follows from the lax-monoidal unit/composition formulas. Form c1 by Yoneda precomposition with Ext.mk0 of that unit. The single-functor Ext realization formula identifies its Hom with functorialCupForget of alpha.

The exact derived single-unit comparison identifies this same ordinary Hom with supportedDerivedUnit followed by supportedExactDerivedMap of kappa. Apply the proved ordinary_supported_kummer_chern to hKappa. The result is global and also covers the empty divisor. Apply the forget_support law of supportedCupFunctoriality to the ordinary etale Hom representative; this is precisely the last site-comparison equality.

theorem normalizedCartier_forget (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {D T : Scheme.{u}} (a : T ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k))
    (i : D ⟶ T) [IsClosedImmersion i] (hI : i.ker.IsInvertible)
    (κ : Abelian.Ext
      ((Etale.lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) i).obj (P.constantEtale D))
      (P.frameTwistEtale T 1) 2)
    (α : P.FunctorialCupH false i 2 1) (hα : HEq κ.hom α)
    (hκ : Etale.SupportedKummerBoundary P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
      P.diagonalExponent_annihilates i hI (P.diagonalExponent_isUnit a) κ) :
    divisorChernSpecification
      (P.divisorOrdinaryHom T)
      (P.divisorOrdinaryRealization T)
      (Etale.supportedKummerChern P.Coefficient P.diagonalExponent
        P.diagonalExponent_annihilates i hI (P.diagonalExponent_isUnit a))
      (P.functorialCupForget true i 2 1 (P.functorialCupCompare i 2 1 α))
      (P.functorialCupOrdinaryCompare T 2 1)
